name: channel-stats
description: YouTube channel numbers in Claude Code: subscribers and views of your channels in the status line, refreshed every 30 minutes, and a /stats table with the change since yesterday. Uses a YouTube Data API key.

apiKey.title: YouTube API key
apiKey.description: A YouTube Data API v3 key from the Google Cloud console. Kept in secure storage.

configFile.title: Channels file
configFile.description: JSON file listing the channels to watch. Default ~/.claude-mods/channel-stats.json

keyFile.title: API key file
keyFile.description: File holding the key on its first line, used when no key is set above (for a mod loaded from a folder). Default ~/.claude-mods/youtube-api-key
